content.short: Realio is an RWA-focused Layer 1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK for institutional digital securities.
content.description:
Realio Network is a premier decentralized Layer 1 ecosystem engineered specifically for the issuance and management of digitally native real-world assets (RWAs). Built using the Cosmos SDK and being fully EVM-compatible, the network provides institutional-grade infrastructure for tokenizing high-value assets such as real estate and private equity. The ecosystem utilizes a unique dual-token system: $RIO for network gas and utility, and $RST as a digital security token that represents equity in the Realio platform.

By leveraging the interoperability of the Cosmos IBC and the security of a Tendermint-based consensus, Realio delivers a scalable and transparent environment for on-chain asset management. The platform is designed to bridge the gap between traditional finance and decentralized technology, providing the compliance and efficiency typically found only in centralized environments. Through its commitment to regulatory alignment and technical innovation, Realio Network is building the essential framework for a more inclusive global financial system.
